title: Discord Desktop data
whyItMatters: Discord stores cached chats, tokens and downloads in its profile folder. It shows which servers the user took part in.
source: DC3 technical advisory: Discord on macOS stores files under ~/Library/Application Support/discord (lowercase)
notes: Folder name is lowercase on macOS. Unconfirmed (no Mac to test): macOS 27 may block this path with com.apple.macl even with Full Disk Access; treat that as a permission skip.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save any file or image you downloaded through Discord that you still need, because the local cache goes with it.
cleanup.signOut: In Discord open User Settings and choose Log Out, so the session on this Mac ends.
steps: Quit Discord so its cached files are not in use.
Move Discord to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the discord folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Cached chats, session tokens and downloads for the Discord account are removed from this Mac.
cleanup.source: Discord, How do I log out?: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/209572128-How-do-I-log-out
